own_solution.law: For equal launch and landing elevations, projectile motion gives t = 2v sin(theta)/g and R = v² sin(2theta)/g. Lowering the current launch direction by q changes theta to 35° - q.
assumptions: Gravity is uniform with g = 9.8 m/s².
Launch and landing elevations are equal.
The ramp beside the launch point does not intercept the ball.
The launch speed remains 20 m/s after adjustment.
The launcher returns to its initial setting after each trial, as stated.
